beta_reference: common-angle steady rotation at beta about 71.5-71.8 degrees, horizontal fixture, gas spring installed (left 2026-11-10, right 2026-11-11)

left_hip.derivation: left measured, gas-subtracted common-angle bidirectional steady motion (mode 1 turn/turn2)
left_hip.outside_measured_speed_and_posture_domai: not identified; no validated extrapolation rule
left_hip.interpretation: effective installed motor/gear/bearing/cable moving friction, not isolated motor internals

left_knee.derivation: left measured, gas-subtracted common-angle bidirectional steady motion (mode 1 turn/turn2)
left_knee.outside_measured_speed_and_posture_domai: not identified; no validated extrapolation rule
left_knee.interpretation: effective installed motor/gear/bearing/cable moving friction plus gas-spring seal drag, not isolated motor internals

right_hip.derivation: right measured, gas-subtracted common-angle bidirectional steady motion (2026-11-11 右腿双电机髋关节联合辨识.csv, mode 1, rev 7, beta 71.7)
right_hip.outside_measured_speed_and_posture_domai: not identified; no validated extrapolation rule
right_hip.interpretation: effective installed motor/gear/bearing/cable moving friction, hot (46-91 C); the upper range allows for colder operation

right_knee.derivation: right measured, gas-subtracted common-angle bidirectional steady motion (mode 1) plus knee open/close half-difference (2026-11-11 右腿膝关节辨识.csv, mode 2)
right_knee.outside_measured_speed_and_posture_domai: not identified; no validated extrapolation rule
right_knee.interpretation: common rotation 1.5-2.0 Nm but knee open/close 3.3-4.1 Nm (gas-spring seal / passive-joint drag on beta motion, not separable per axis). The per-axis Coulomb prior spans both motion types; nominal is their midpoint.

supersedes.reason: right leg measured 2026-11-11; replaces the left/right symmetry assumption for the right side only

left_right_comparison.caveat: right runs were 20-30 C hotter; part of the lower right plateau may be temperature
